json-formatter.pageDescription: JSONをオンラインでフォーマット、整形、圧縮、検証。
json-formatter.seoContent: JSON (JavaScript Object Notation) is a lightweight data-interchange format. This JSON formatter tool helps you format, beautify, minify, and validate JSON data. Simply paste your JSON, click Format, and get a clean, readable output. Perfect for debugging API responses, config files, and data processing.
json-formatter.seoFeature1: Format & beautify JSON with custom indentation (2, 4, or 8 spaces)
json-formatter.seoFeature3: Validate JSON syntax with detailed error messages
json-formatter.seoFeature4: 100%クライアント側処理 — データはブラウザから送信されません

faqs.a: JSON formatting is the process of adding proper indentation, line breaks, and spacing to JSON data to make it more readable. It doesn't change the data itself, just its visual presentation.

faqs.q: Is this JSON formatter safe to use?
faqs.a: Yes, 100% safe. All processing happens directly in your browser. Your JSON data is never sent to any server or stored anywhere.

faqs.q: Can I validate JSON with this tool?
faqs.a: Yes. Click the Validate button to check if your JSON is syntactically correct. The tool will show detailed error messages if any issues are found.

howToUseSteps: Paste your JSON data into the input field on the left
Choose your preferred indentation (2, 4, or 8 spaces)
Click 'Format / Beautify' for readable output, or 'Minify' for compact output
Copy the result using the copy button

base64.name: Base64エンコーダー/デコーダー
base64.description: テキストをBase64にエンコード、Base64をデコード
base64.pageTitle: Base64エンコーダー / デコーダー
base64.pageDescription: テキストをBase64にエンコード、Base64をデコード。UTF-8対応。
base64.seoContent: Base64 is a binary-to-text encoding scheme that represents binary data in an ASCII string format. It's commonly used for encoding data in URLs, emails, HTML, and APIs. This tool supports full UTF-8 encoding and decoding.

faqs.a: Base64 is a binary-to-text encoding scheme that converts binary data into ASCII characters. It's commonly used to transmit data safely over text-based protocols like HTTP and email.

faqs.q: Is Base64 encoding the same as encryption?
faqs.a: No. Base64 is an encoding scheme, not encryption. Anyone can decode Base64 data. It's meant for data transport, not security.
Yes. This tool fully supports UTF-8 encoding and decoding, allowing you to work with international characters and emojis.

howToUseSteps: Enter your plain text in the top field to encode, or Base64 string in the bottom field to decode
Click 'Encode' to convert text to Base64, or 'Decode' to convert Base64 back to text
Copy the result with the copy button
useCases: Encoding images for embedding in HTML/CSS
Transmitting binary data in JSON APIs

url-encoder.name: URLエンコーダー/デコーダー
url-encoder.description: URLコンポーネントとクエリパラメータのエンコード/デコード
url-encoder.pageTitle: URLエンコーダー / デコーダー
url-encoder.pageDescription: URLとURIコンポーネントのエンコード/デコード。
url-encoder.seoContent: URL encoding replaces unsafe ASCII characters with a "%" followed by two hexadecimal digits. This is essential for passing special characters in URLs, query parameters, and form data. Use encodeURIComponent for query parameters and encodeURI for full URLs.

faqs.a: URL encoding replaces unsafe ASCII characters with a '%' followed by two hex digits. This ensures special characters are safely transmitted in URLs.

faqs.q: What's the difference between encodeURI and encodeURIComponent?
faqs.a: encodeURI encodes a full URL but preserves characters like :, /, ?, &. encodeURIComponent encodes everything including those characters, making it suitable for query parameter values.
Always URL encode when passing user input as query parameters, form data, or any URL component that may contain special characters like spaces, &, =, or #.

howToUseSteps: Enter text in the input field
Choose between URI Component or Full URI encoding mode
Click 'Encode' or 'Decode'
Copy the result
useCases: Handling special characters in API requests

hash-generator.name: ハッシュジェネレーター
hash-generator.description: テキストからMD5、SHA-1、SHA-256、SHA-512ハッシュを生成
hash-generator.pageTitle: ハッシュジェネレーター
hash-generator.pageDescription: 任意のテキストからSHA-1、SHA-256、SHA-384、SHA-512ハッシュを生成。
hash-generator.seoContent: Cryptographic hash functions generate a fixed-size hash value from input data. They're used for data integrity verification, password storage, digital signatures, and more. SHA-256 is the most commonly used algorithm today.

faqs.a: A hash function takes input data and produces a fixed-size string of characters (hash). The same input always produces the same hash, but you cannot reverse a hash back to the original data.

faqs.q: Which hash algorithm should I use?
faqs.a: SHA-256 is recommended for most purposes. SHA-512 offers more security. MD5 and SHA-1 are considered weak for security but are still used for checksums.
Yes. All hash computation happens in your browser using the Web Crypto API. No data is sent to any server.

howToUseSteps: Enter or paste your text in the input field
Click 'Generate Hashes' to compute all hash values
Toggle 'Uppercase' for uppercase hex output
Copy any hash value with the copy button

uuid-generator.name: UUIDジェネレーター
uuid-generator.description: ランダムUUID (v4) を一括生成
uuid-generator.pageDescription: ランダムUUID (v4) を一括生成。大文字、ハイフンなし対応。
uuid-generator.emptyState: Click "Generate UUIDs" to create random UUIDs
uuid-generator.seoContent: UUID (Universally Unique Identifier) v4 generates random 128-bit identifiers. With 122 random bits, the probability of a collision is astronomically low. UUIDs are commonly used as database primary keys, session tokens, and distributed system identifiers.

faqs.a: UUID (Universally Unique Identifier) is a 128-bit number used to uniquely identify information. Version 4 UUIDs are randomly generated, making collision probability astronomically low.
While not mathematically guaranteed, UUID v4 has 2^122 possible values. The probability of generating a duplicate is essentially zero for practical purposes.
Use UUIDs as database primary keys, API resource identifiers, session tokens, or any time you need a unique identifier without a central authority.

howToUseSteps: Set the number of UUIDs to generate (1-20)
Choose options: uppercase, no dashes
Click 'Generate UUIDs'
Click on any UUID to copy, or use 'Copy All'

timestamp-converter.name: Unixタイムスタンプ変換
timestamp-converter.description: Unixタイムスタンプと日付を相互変換
timestamp-converter.pageDescription: Unixタイムスタンプを日付に、日付をタイムスタンプに変換。
timestamp-converter.seoContent: A Unix timestamp represents the number of seconds since January 1, 1970 (UTC). It's widely used in programming, databases, and APIs. This tool auto-detects whether the input is in seconds or milliseconds.

faqs.a: A Unix timestamp is the number of seconds elapsed since January 1, 1970 00:00:00 UTC (the Unix epoch). It's a universal way to represent time in computing.

faqs.q: What's the difference between seconds and milliseconds?
faqs.a: Unix timestamps in seconds are 10 digits (e.g., 1700000000), while milliseconds are 13 digits (e.g., 1700000000000). JavaScript uses milliseconds, most systems use seconds.
Yes. The tool shows both UTC and your local timezone when converting timestamps, so you can see the exact time in both.

howToUseSteps: Enter a Unix timestamp to convert to a human-readable date
Or enter a date string to convert to a Unix timestamp
The tool auto-detects seconds vs milliseconds
View results in UTC, local time, and ISO format
useCases: Converting API timestamps to readable dates
Working with JWT token expiration times

faqs.q: What's the difference between HEX, RGB, and HSL?
faqs.a: HEX uses hexadecimal notation. RGB defines colors by red, green, blue values (0-255). HSL uses hue (0-360), saturation, and lightness percentages.

faqs.q: Can I use the color picker?
faqs.a: Yes. Use the built-in color picker to visually select a color, and all format values will update automatically.

All other formats update automatically in real-time
Use the color picker for visual selection

Adjusting colors with HSL for hue/saturation tweaks

regex-tester.description: 正規表現をリアルタイムでマッチ＆ハイライト

regex-tester.seoContent: Regular expressions (regex) are powerful patterns used for matching, searching, and replacing text. They're essential for input validation, text processing, and data extraction. This tool tests your regex in real-time with JavaScript's regex engine.

faqs.q: How do I test my regex?
faqs.a: Enter your regex pattern in the pattern field, add test text below, and the tool will highlight all matches in real-time. Flags like 'g' (global) and 'i' (case-insensitive) are supported.
Yes. All regex processing happens in your browser using JavaScript's built-in RegExp engine. No data is sent anywhere.

Type or paste your test text
View highlighted matches and match details in real-time

Extracting data from text (log parsing, web scraping)

jwt-decoder.name: JWTデコーダー
jwt-decoder.description: JSON Web Tokenをデコードしてヘッダー、ペイロード、署名を確認
jwt-decoder.pageDescription: JSON Web Tokenをデコード。ヘッダー、ペイロード、署名を表示。

jwt-decoder.seoContent: JWT (JSON Web Token) is a compact, URL-safe token format used for authentication and information exchange. A JWT consists of three parts: Header (algorithm & type), Payload (claims & data), and Signature (verification). JWTs are commonly used in OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, and API authentication.

faqs.a: JWT (JSON Web Token) is a compact, URL-safe token format used for authentication and information exchange. It contains a header, payload, and signature.

faqs.q: Is it safe to decode JWTs here?
faqs.a: Yes. Decoding happens entirely in your browser. No tokens are sent to any server. Note: decoding only reads the token — it does not verify the signature.

faqs.q: Can this tool verify JWT signatures?
faqs.a: This tool decodes and displays the token contents. Signature verification requires the secret key, which should not be entered into any online tool.

howToUseSteps: Paste your JWT token in the input field
The header, payload, and signature are decoded automatically
View expiration time and other claims
Copy decoded sections as needed

html-entity.name: HTMLエンティティエンコーダー
html-entity.description: HTMLエンティティと特殊文字のエンコード/デコード
html-entity.pageTitle: HTMLエンティティエンコーダー / デコーダー
html-entity.pageDescription: 特殊文字をHTMLエンティティにエンコード、またはデコード。
html-entity.seoContent: HTML entities are special codes used to display reserved characters in HTML. Characters like <, >, &, and \" must be encoded to prevent them from being interpreted as HTML markup. This is crucial for preventing XSS attacks and displaying code snippets.

faqs.a: HTML entities are special codes that represent characters that have meaning in HTML (like <, >, &) or characters not available on a standard keyboard.

faqs.q: When should I encode HTML entities?
faqs.a: Encode when displaying user input in HTML to prevent XSS attacks, or when you need to display special characters like ©, ™, or mathematical symbols.

faqs.q: Does this handle all special characters?
faqs.a: Yes. This tool handles all standard HTML entities including named entities (&), decimal (&), and hexadecimal (&) formats.

howToUseSteps: Enter HTML text or entities in the input field
Click 'Encode' to convert special characters to HTML entities
Click 'Decode' to convert HTML entities back to readable text
Copy the result
useCases: Preventing XSS attacks by escaping user input
Displaying code snippets in HTML pages
Working with special characters in web content

css-minifier.name: CSS圧縮 / 整形
css-minifier.pageDescription: 本番用にCSSを圧縮、または可読性のために整形。
css-minifier.seoContent: CSS minification removes unnecessary characters like whitespace, comments, and semicolons to reduce file size. Smaller CSS files load faster, improving website performance and user experience. Use beautify mode to make minified CSS readable again.

faqs.a: CSS minification removes whitespace, comments, and unnecessary characters from CSS code to reduce file size and improve page load speed.

faqs.q: Does minification change my CSS behavior?
faqs.a: No. Minification only removes formatting — it doesn't change how your CSS works. The minified version produces identical visual results.

faqs.q: How much file size can I save?
faqs.a: Typically 20-40% reduction depending on the original formatting. Heavily commented files may see even greater savings.

howToUseSteps: Paste your CSS code in the input field
Click 'Minify' to remove whitespace and comments
Or click 'Beautify' to format compressed CSS for readability
Copy the result for your project

number-base.name: 進数変換
number-base.helperText: Type a number in any field and the other bases will be calculated automatically.
number-base.seoContent: Different number base systems are used in computing: Binary (base 2) for machine-level operations, Octal (base 8) for Unix permissions, Decimal (base 10) for everyday use, and Hexadecimal (base 16) for memory addresses, colors, and compact binary representation.

faqs.a: Number bases (or radixes) are systems for representing numbers. Common bases: binary (base 2), octal (base 8), decimal (base 10), and hexadecimal (base 16).
Hexadecimal is compact and maps neatly to binary — each hex digit represents exactly 4 binary bits. It's widely used for colors, memory addresses, and byte values.
Binary (base 2) is the fundamental language of computers. Understanding binary helps with bitwise operations, networking (IP addresses), and low-level programming.

howToUseSteps: Enter a number in any base (binary, octal, decimal, or hex)
All other base conversions update automatically
Copy any converted value with the copy button
useCases: Converting between hex and binary for programming

text-diff.seoContent: Text diff compares two versions of text and highlights the differences. It's essential for code review, document comparison, and tracking changes. Green lines indicate additions, red lines indicate removals.

faqs.a: A text diff compares two texts and highlights the differences — additions, deletions, and unchanged lines. It's similar to how Git shows code changes.
This tool uses a line-by-line comparison algorithm that identifies added, removed, and unchanged lines between the two texts.
Yes. The diff tool works with any text including source code, configuration files, documentation, or plain text.

word-counter.seoContent: This word counter tool provides detailed text statistics including word count, character count (with and without spaces), sentence count, paragraph count, and estimated reading time. faqs.q: Does it work with non-English text?

cron-parser.name: Cron式パーサー

cron-parser.seoContent: Cron is a time-based job scheduler in Unix-like systems. A cron expression consists of 5 fields: minute, hour, day of month, month, and day of week. Special characters include * (any), / (step), , (list), and - (range). Used extensively in CI/CD, scheduled tasks, and automation.

faqs.a: A cron expression is a string of 5 fields (minute, hour, day, month, weekday) that defines a schedule for recurring tasks in Unix-like systems.

faqs.q: What do the special characters mean?
faqs.a: * means any value, / means step (*/5 = every 5), , means list (1,3,5), - means range (1-5), and specific numbers mean exact values.

faqs.q: Can I see when my cron job will run next?

slug-generator.name: URLスラッグ生成
slug-generator.description: テキストをSEOフレンドリーなURLスラッグに変換
slug-generator.pageDescription: 任意のテキストをクリーンなSEOフレンドリーなURLスラッグに変換。
slug-generator.inputPlaceholder: Enter a title or text to convert to a slug...
slug-generator.seoContent: A URL slug is the part of a URL that identifies a page in a human-readable form. Good slugs are short, descriptive, and SEO-friendly. They typically use lowercase letters, hyphens as separators, and avoid special characters. This tool helps you generate clean slugs from any text, with options for stop word removal and length limits.

faqs.a: A slug is the human-readable part of a URL that identifies a specific page. For example, in '/blog/how-to-code', 'how-to-code' is the slug.

faqs.q: Why are slugs important for SEO?
faqs.a: Search engines use slugs to understand page content. Clean, descriptive slugs with relevant keywords can improve search rankings and click-through rates.
Stop words are common words like 'the', 'a', 'in', 'on' that add little meaning. Removing them creates shorter, cleaner slugs.

howToUseSteps: Enter a title or text in the input field
The slug generates automatically in real-time
Customize: toggle lowercase, stop word removal, separator type, and max length
Copy the generated slug or preview the full URL
useCases: Creating URL slugs for blog posts
Building permalink structures for CMS systems

chmod-calculator.name: Chmod計算
chmod-calculator.description: チェックボックスでLinuxファイル権限を計算
chmod-calculator.pageDescription: chmod権限の計算。数値(755)と記号(rwxr-xr-x)を相互変換。
chmod-calculator.seoContent: Linux file permissions control who can read (r), write (w), and execute (x) files and directories. Permissions are set for three groups: owner, group, and others. The chmod command uses either numeric (octal) notation like 755 or symbolic notation like rwxr-xr-x. Common values: 755 for directories/scripts, 644 for regular files, 600 for private files.

faqs.a: chmod (change mode) is a Unix/Linux command that sets file and directory permissions. It controls who can read, write, and execute files.
755 means: owner can read/write/execute (7), group can read/execute (5), others can read/execute (5). It's the standard permission for directories and scripts.

faqs.q: What's the difference between numeric and symbolic notation?
faqs.a: Numeric uses octal digits (755). Symbolic uses letters (rwxr-xr-x). They represent the same permissions — numeric is more compact, symbolic is more readable.

howToUseSteps: Click checkboxes to set read/write/execute permissions for owner, group, and others
Or type a numeric permission (e.g., 755) to auto-set checkboxes
View the numeric, symbolic, and command representations
Click a common permission preset for quick setup
useCases: Setting up web server file permissions
Securing sensitive files (SSH keys, config files)

line-sorter.seoContent: Line sorting is a common text processing task in programming and data management. This tool provides multiple sorting options: alphabetical (A-Z, Z-A), numeric, and by line length. It also supports removing duplicate lines, reversing order, random shuffling, trimming whitespace, and adding line numbers. All processing happens in your browser.

faqs.a: Alphabetical (A-Z, Z-A), numeric, by line length. Plus: remove duplicates, reverse order, random shuffle, trim whitespace, and add line numbers.
Empty lines are automatically removed during processing to keep results clean. Use 'Trim Lines' to also remove leading/trailing whitespace.
Yes. All processing happens in your browser, so it handles thousands of lines quickly without any server dependency.

howToUseSteps: Paste your text with one item per line in the input field

js-html-formatter.name: JS/HTMLフォーマッター
js-html-formatter.pageTitle: JavaScript & HTML圧縮器 / 整形器
js-html-formatter.pageDescription: JavaScriptとHTMLをオンラインで圧縮または整形。
js-html-formatter.seoContent: Minifying JavaScript and HTML removes unnecessary characters like whitespace, comments, and line breaks to reduce file size and improve page load speed. Beautifying does the opposite — adding proper indentation and formatting for readability. This tool supports both JavaScript and HTML with instant results in your browser.

faqs.q: Does minification change how my code works?
faqs.a: No. Minification only removes formatting — whitespace, comments, and line breaks. The code logic and behavior remain identical.

faqs.q: How much file size can I save?
faqs.a: Typically 20-50% for JavaScript and 10-30% for HTML, depending on the original formatting and comment density.

faqs.q: Is this a full JavaScript parser?
faqs.a: This is a lightweight formatter designed for quick minification and beautification. For production builds, use dedicated tools like Terser or esbuild.

howToUseSteps: Select JavaScript or HTML mode
Paste your code in the input field
Click 'Minify' to compress or 'Beautify' to format
Copy the result

image-base64.name: 画像Base64変換
image-base64.description: 画像をBase64文字列とdata URIに変換。ドラッグ＆ドロップ対応
image-base64.pageDescription: 画像をBase64文字列とdata URIに変換。PNG、JPG、GIF、SVG、WebP対応。
image-base64.dropText: Drop an image here or click to select
image-base64.supportedFormats: Supports PNG, JPG, GIF, SVG, WebP, ICO
image-base64.decodePlaceholder: Paste a Base64 string or data:image/png;base64,... URI here
image-base64.seoContent: Converting images to Base64 strings allows you to embed them directly in HTML, CSS, or JSON without separate image files. This is useful for small icons (under 10KB), email templates, and reducing HTTP requests. The trade-off is a ~33% increase in data size compared to the binary original.

faqs.a: PNG, JPG/JPEG, GIF, SVG, WebP, ICO, and BMP. Any image format your browser can display.

faqs.q: Is there a file size limit?
faqs.a: No hard limit, but Base64 encoding increases size by ~33%. Images over 10KB are generally not recommended for Base64 embedding.

faqs.q: Is my image uploaded to a server?
faqs.a: No. All conversion happens entirely in your browser. Your images never leave your device.

howToUseSteps: Drag & drop an image or click to select a file
View the Base64 string, data URI, HTML tag, and CSS snippet
Copy any format you need
Switch to 'Base64 → Image' tab to decode
useCases: Reducing HTTP requests for small assets

git-command-generator.name: Gitコマンド生成
git-command-generator.description: ビジュアルGitコマンドビルダー
git-command-generator.pageDescription: 操作を選択し、パラメータを入力してコマンドをコピー。
git-command-generator.seoContent: Git is the most widely used version control system in the world. While powerful, its command-line interface has a steep learning curve. This tool helps you build Git commands visually — select the operation you need, fill in parameters like branch names or commit messages, and copy the complete command. Covers 40+ common Git operations organized by category.

faqs.q: Does this tool run Git commands?
faqs.a: No. This tool generates Git command strings for you to copy and paste into your terminal. No commands are executed.
Over 40 operations: init, clone, branch, checkout, commit, push, pull, merge, rebase, cherry-pick, stash, reset, revert, tag, and more.
Yes. Click on any command to expand it and fill in parameters like branch names, commit messages, file paths, etc. The command updates in real-time.

howToUseSteps: Select a category (Branch, Commit, Push & Pull, etc.)
Click on the operation you need
Fill in the parameters (branch name, message, etc.)
Copy the generated command and paste it in your terminal
useCases: Learning Git commands as a beginner
Reference guide for less common operations (cherry-pick, rebase, stash)
